admission.justification: Avoids stealing modified browser chords or silently losing existing task navigation when adding parent arrows.

applicability: Keyboard interaction on the focused Operations list parent row.
conditions: Only unmodified left/right arrows toggle parents.
Non-parent rows and completed-fold lines retain their existing keyboard behavior.
A selected ancestor held open for the chosen document cannot be collapsed by the left arrow (INV-ME6CA1; MIK-R144 rule 3).
exclusions: Changing up/down, Enter or typeahead reach.

evidence: dashboard/src/panels/lifecycle-list/hierarchy.test.tsx: "opens and closes a parent row with the right and left arrow keys"; sandbox tries in notes/run3/operations-sidebar-proposal/comparison/behave.json (arrowKeys, both widths) and captures/foldkey.json; comparison page, section "The one addition".

statement: With a parent row in the keyboard's focus the right arrow opens it and the left arrow closes it unless the chosen document holds that ancestor open; on a task row and on the line of completed ones the two keys do nothing; with Alt, Ctrl, Shift or Meta held they are left to the browser; up, down, Enter and typing reach the rows as before.
